test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b659760af23ea32241fcb57574f2270206e7c25bdec73807384bb009effba53f.png]
solution:
The pattern in the given series is:

 
• **In each step, the number of sides increase of the shape **
 
• **Number of sides = number of partition in that shape **

 For example: Triangle - number of sides 3, number of partition 3

The next step will be:

**A heptagon (7 sides) will be placed** since a hexagon was placed in the previous step.

**There will be 7 partitions in the heptagon.**

From the options:

Option 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/479e9c65af8b236f070bd4299a25ac82e741689fc61a379900c7294bfbdf4f80.png] This is an octagon with 9 partitions. This option is incorrect.

Option 2)
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7eb67e0642c40280f30a690d9724a41155bfd8ff9d23a6ff18669c990b3a9bf.png] This is an heptagon with 7 partitions. 

Option 3)
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f9e60078ada3fe98cecea58ec23488e6fb9bc51358f68efb7df0b84ed9af738.png] This is an octagon with 8 partitions. This option is incorrect.

Option 4)
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/904e817f4fd654b16dee6581de36cae3a98eed6c860972c7b430ec80f5bdc16d.png] This is an heptagon with 6 partitions. This option is incorrect.

**Hence the correct answer is option 2.**
